what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Cuba, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, IDMC recorded 753000 new displacements by disasters inside Cuba: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Cuba list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Cuba.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, and the 2025 figure is the latest.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced above zero.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Cuba.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
